- KYB / KYC onboarding and entity verification (existence, active status, standing)

## Ultimate Screenshot

A webpage capture Actor that drives a real browser to render and save web pages as JPEG or PNG images, printable PDFs, short MP4 recordings or GIF animations. It renders JavaScript, web fonts and lazy-loaded content, supports authenticated sessions via supplied cookies, and emulates devices using a large set of phone/tablet presets or custom viewport sizes. Capture modes include visible-viewport or whole-page rasterization, scroll-driven recordings that pan through a page and static recordings that hold the viewport, with configurable recording duration and frame rate. The Actor can apply CSS selectors to hide elements before rendering, wait for page elements to appear, adjust image quality and PDF paper/margins/orientation, and route requests through proxies including residential proxies. Outputs are finished files (images, PDFs, MP4/GIF) plus per-page metadata describing result status, final URL after redirects, HTTP status, page title, file type and size, capture duration, recording frames/duration where applicable, and processing notes.

## Use cases

- Agencies archiving client websites and creating visual records
- QA and product teams performing visual checks and pixel comparisons
- Marketers producing scroll-through clips or demos of landing pages
- Bulk archiving of pages for thumbnails and previews
- Design review and lossless image comparisons using PNG captures
- Generating printable PDF reports, invoices or compliance records
- Creating short landing-page walkthroughs and demo videos (MP4/GIF)
- Producing GIFs for social posts, documentation and changelog entries
- Capturing pages that require authentication (signed-in account screenshots)
- Removing cookie banners, chat widgets or sticky headers before capture via CSS selectors

- Video asset extraction with all quality variants and bitrate metadata for media analysis

- Real estate investors collecting inventory, pricing and price-per-area data across cities and neighbourhoods.

- Country-specific property harvesting using localized filters (examples: Portuguese quintas/manor houses, Italian auctions/casali, sea-view types).  
- Enrichment of property records with media assets and advertiser contact/type information for lead generation or inventory validation.

## Google Ads Intelligence Scraper

A scraper that extracts advertising data from Google's Ads Transparency Center for competitive and research workflows. - Competitive intelligence: track competitor ad creatives, formats, messaging, and estimated spend/reach.
- Market research: analyze advertising patterns across industries and regions.
- Political and election research: monitor political ad spend ranges, impression ranges, and demographic targeting by region.
- Media and campaign planning: inform platform selection, geographic targeting, and creative direction based on active ads and formats.
- Brand monitoring and business intelligence: discover current advertising activity for brand tracking, partnership discovery, and market-entry research.
- Academic research and transparency journalism: study advertising trends, accountability, and disclosure data published in the Ads Transparency Center.

## Use cases

- Bulk image downloads (thumbnails, avatars, screenshots) without filename overwrites

- Zoom recording collection by converting Zoom HLS clips to downloadable MP4 files  
- Media collection: bulk video, image, and audio downloads with proxy support for geo-restricted sources

- Software distribution: downloading executables, installers, and software packages for deployment or analysis  
- API integration: deploy as a standby HTTP API server for webhook-driven download endpoints  
- Backup operations: automated backups of web-hosted files and resources

A DoorDash-focused web scraper that extracts store listings, full menus, featured items, and customer reviews from DoorDash via location-aware search URLs or direct store URLs. Extracted data includes store identity and taxonomy, ratings and star-distribution, pricing and fee details (delivery/pickup fees and surge indicators), availability and ETA information with unavailability reasons, capability flags (delivery, pickup, group ordering, scheduling, catering, drone), full address and GPS coordinates with distance and timezone, media and UGC photos with UUIDs, featured-items carousel data with grid positions, recommendation signals and badges, complete menu categories and per-item metadata (prices, positions, ratings, badges, customization/quick-add signals), menu hours, and optional review extraction that captures full review text, star rating, verification status, timestamps, reviewer metadata, and marked-up review text linking mentions to specific menu items. - Location-aware keyword search to discover DoorDash stores for a specific delivery address or area
- Scrape a single DoorDash store by its direct store URL to obtain complete store profile and menu
- Batch-scrape multiple DoorDash search and store URLs in one run for aggregation and cross-comparison
- Extract customer reviews and link in-text item mentions back to menu items for item-level sentiment and feedback analysis
- Collect featured-items carousel data and recommendation signals for menu optimization and product ranking analysis

- Build geospatial inventories of stores with GPS coordinates, distance-from-address calculations, and timezones
- Aggregate media and UGC photos (with UUIDs) for visual asset inventories and image analysis

A web scraper for Google Flights that captures live fares, schedules, airlines and aircraft for one-way, round-trip, multi-city and Explore searches; it replays Google Flights result links or builds equivalent searches with native Google filters to return one record per flight option containing the true total price for the itinerary, per-segment details, itinerary duration and times, CO2 emissions estimates, which Google filters were applied, and a link to open the flight in Google Flights. Optional extras include Google's booking options (airline and agency fare tiers, fare names, bag fees and seller links), return-flight lists for round trips, and a date-based price graph and Explore destination pricing. Technical capabilities: browser-based scraping that handles Google’s Best or Cheapest lists, applies or reproduces Google filters (stops, alliances/airlines, carry-on bags, price caps, times, emissions, layover/connectivity and duration, cabin class), supports multi-origin/multi-destination batches, market/currency/language selection, retries on residential IPs for optional details, and returns structured, filter-labelled flight and calendar/destination records suitable for monitoring, comparison and downstream analytics without requiring a Google account or API key.

## Use cases

- Flight price monitoring and alerting to detect price drops on routes
- Live fare comparison for travel agencies, OTAs and booking tools
- Airfare research across carriers, alliances, cabins, markets and currencies
- Revenue management and competitor pricing surveillance for airline routes
- Deal sites and newsletters surfacing cheapest fares and self-transfer combinations, plus Explore cheapest-destination discovery
- Fare comparison showing every airline/agency fare tier, bag fees and booking links
- Data and AI use cases: clean, filter-labelled flight datasets for dashboards, models and agents

- Job boards and aggregators: populate niche job listings by scraping public postings  
- Job seeker monitoring: watch for new postings in a niche and identify the named recruiter  
- Competitive intelligence: monitor competitor hiring activity and headcount signals

- Bulk data collection for e-commerce sellers, brand and market researchers, and data teams needing Shopee review data at scale.
